questions.topic: Simple diode circuits: clipping, clamping, rectifiers
questions.question_text:
Consider the circuit shown. Assume that the diode (\(D\)) is ideal.
[IMAGE_Q_61_1]
Given \(v_s = 100\sin(2\pi 50t)\) V, \(V_{dc} = 50\) V, and \(R = 10\ \Omega\), the average value of the current through the diode is ___________ A
(Round off to two decimal places)

questions.subject: Complex Variables
questions.question_text:
The magnitude of the contour integral
\[\oint_C \left(\frac{(z+1)^2}{(z-i)(z-2)}\right) dz\]
over the contour \(C: |z - 2 - i| = 3/2\) is ______
(Round off to two decimal places)
Note: \(z\) is a complex variable and \(i = \sqrt{-1}\)

questions.subject: Electromagnetic Fields
questions.topic: Electric field and potential due to point, line, plane and spherical charge distributions
questions.question_text:
A uniform spherical volume charge distribution of radius 2 m, centered at the origin, has a strength of \(\frac{3}{\pi} \times 10^{-6}\) C/m\(^3\). A point charge of strength \(\pi \times 8.854 \times 10^{-12}\) C is moved from (– 3, 0, – 4) to (0, 0, 4) in Cartesian coordinate system. The relative permittivity of the medium is 1 and the coordinate values are in meters.
The work done during the process is ______ μJ
(Round off to two decimal places)

questions.subject: Probability and Statistics
questions.question_text:
Let X and Y be two real-valued random variables with \(E(X) = 1\), \(E(Y) = 2\), \(E(X^2) = 4\), \(E(Y^2) = 9\), and \(E(XY) = 0.9\), where E denotes the expectation operator.
The value of \(\alpha\) that minimizes \(E((X - \alpha Y)^2)\) is __________
(Round off to one decimal place)

questions.subject: Calculus
questions.topic: Evaluation of definite and improper integrals
questions.question_text:
The integral
\[\frac{1}{\pi}\int_0^{\infty} \frac{x^{2026}}{(1 + x^{2026})(1 + x^2)}\,dx\]
evaluates to _________
(Round off to two decimal places)
